ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ ۚ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًٔا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ ۖ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا الْأُخْرَى ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ ۖ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَٰرَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا ۗ وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ ۚ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا فُرَٰدَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَتَرَكْتُم مَّا خَوَّلْنَٰكُمْ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِكُمْ ۖ وَمَا نَرَىٰ مَعَكُمْ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّهُمْ فِيكُمْ شُرَكَٰٓؤُا۟ ۚ لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنكُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ

ضَالٌّ ḍāll [act. part.; pl. ضَالُّون ḍāllūn]

1 one who has lost his way (in an interpretation of 68:26) فَلَمَّا‏ ‏رَأَوْهَا‏ ‏قَالُوا‏ ‏إِنَّا‏ ‏لَضَالُّونَ when they saw [the garden], they said, ‘We must have lost our way’ (or, ‘Indeed, we have erred!’)

2 one who is bewildered [in an interpretation of 93:6–7] أَلَمْ‏ ‏يَجِدْكَ‏ ‏يَتِيمًا‏ ‏فَآوَى وَوَجَدَكَ‏ ‏ضَالا‏ ‏فَهَدَى‏ did He not find you an orphan and shelter you?; did He not find you bewildered (or, lacking in learning) and guide you?

3 one who is lost

(15:56) وَمَنْ يَقْنَطُ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلاَّ الضَّالُّونَ who despairs of the mercy of their Lord but the lost ones?

4 one who forgets (in an interpretation of 26:20) قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ he [Moses] said: ‘I did it when I was one of the absent‐minded (or, the misguided)’

entries.label: ض-ل-ل
entries.definitionHtml:
ض/ل/ل   ḍ–l–l deviation, loss, to deviate from the right way or course, to lose the way
; to miss something, to be unable to locate something, to become untraceable.

Of this root, 11 forms occur 191 times in the Qur’an:
ضَلَّ ḍalla 52 times; أَضَلَّ ʾaḍalla 64 times; يُضَلّ yuḍall 1 time; ضَالٌّ ḍāll 1 time; ضَالُّون ḍāllūn 13 times; أَضَلّ ʾaḍall 9 times; تَضْلِيلٌ taḍlıl 1 time; مُضِلٌّ muḍill 2 times; مُضِلِّين muḍillın 1 time; ضَلاَلٌ ḍalāl 38 times and ضَلاَلَةٌ ḍalālatun 9 times.

entries.label: أَضَلَّ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَضَلَّ ʾaḍalla [v. IV, imperf., pass. يُضِلّ yuḍill or يُضْلِل yuḍlil] I [trans.]

1 to mislead, to lead astray

(20:79) وَأَضَلَّ‏ ‏فِرْعَوْنُ‏ ‏قَوْمَهُ‏ Pharaoh led his people astray

2 to cause to be of no effect

(47:8) وَالَّذِينَ‏ ‏كَفَرُوا‏ ‏فَتَعْسًا‏ ‏لَهُمْ‏ ‏وَأَضَلَّ‏ ‏أَعْمَالَهُمْ‏ as for the disbelievers, let misfortune befall them–and He will cause their deeds to be in vain

3 to deceive

(4:119) وَلأَُضِلَّنَّهُمْ‏ ‏وَلأَُمَنِّيَنَّهُمْ‏ I will deceive them and incite vain desires in them

4 to let go astray, to let down, to leave to one’s own devices

(45:23) أَفَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَهَهُ هَوَاهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ have you considered the one who takes his own desire as a deity, and whom–in His knowledge–God lets him go astray [leaves him to his own devices]

5 to divert, to distract, to lead away from

(25:42) إِنْ‏ ‏كَادَ‏ ‏لَيُضِلُّنَا‏ ‏عَنْ‏ ‏ءَالِهَتِنَا‏ he would have led us away from our gods II [doubly trans.] to cause someone to lose something

(33:67)‏إِنَّا‏ ‏أَطَعْنَا‏ ‏سَادَتَنَا‏ ‏وَكُبَرَاءَنَا‏ ‏فَأَضَلُّونَا‏ ‏السَّبِيلاَ ‏ we obeyed our leaders and our notables, and they caused us to lose the [right] way.

entries.label: أَضَلُّ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَضَلُّ ʾaḍall [elat.] more/most deviant from the correct path

(5:60) أُولَئِكَ‏ ‏شَرٌّ‏ ‏مَكَانًا‏ ‏وَأَضَلُّ‏ ‏عَنْ‏ ‏سَوَاءِ‏ ‏السَّبِيلِ‏ those are worse situated [most erroneous] and further astray from the right path.

entries.label: تَضْلِيلٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
تَضْلِيلٌ taḍlıl [v. n. of v. II] the act of misleading, causing confusion, causing something to come to nothing

(105:1–2) أَلَمْ‏ ‏تَرَ‏ ‏كَيْفَ‏ ‏فَعَلَ‏ ‏رَبُّكَ‏ ‏بِأَصْحَابِ‏ ‏الْفِيلِ‏ أَلَمْ‏ ‏يَجْعَلْ‏ ‏كَيْدَهُمْ‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏تَضْلِيلٍ‏ have you not considered how your Lord dealt with the army of the elephant?; did He not utterly confound their plans [lit. make their plan into confusion]?

entries.label: ضَلاَلٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
ضَلاَلٌ ḍalāl [v. n./n.]

1 going astray, loss

(3:164)‏وَإِنْ‏ ‏كَانُوا‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏قَبْلُ‏ ‏لَفِي‏ ‏ضَلاَلٍ‏ ‏مُبِينٍ though before they were at a manifest loss

2 error, falsehood

(10:32) فَذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَاذَا بَعْدَ الْحَقِّ إِلاَّ الضَّلاَلُ so that is God, your Lord, the True–what is there, beyond the True God, but falsehood?

3 being in futility, coming to nothing

(40:25)‏وَمَا‏ ‏كَيْدُ‏ ‏الْكَافِرِينَ‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏ضَلاَلٍ‏ the scheming of those who reject the truth can only be nothing

4 confusion, illusion, hallucination

(12:95) قَالُوا‏ ‏تَاللَّهِ‏ ‏إِنَّكَ‏ ‏لَفِي‏ ‏ضَلاَلِكَ‏ ‏الْقَدِيمِ‏ they said, ‘By God! You are still in your old delusion!’

5 being unfair

(12:8) إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِي ضَلاَلٍ مُبِينٍ our father is truly unfair.

entries.label: ضَلاَلَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
ضَلاَلَةٌ ḍalālatun [v. n./n.]

1 utter loss

(19:75)‏مَنْ‏ ‏كَانَ‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏الضَّلاَلَةِ‏ ‏فَلْيَمْدُدْ‏ ‏لَهُ‏ ‏الرَّحْمَنُ‏ ‏مَدًّا‏ whosoever is in utter loss, may the Lord of Mercy grant him respite

2 damnation

(7:30) ‏عَلَيْهِمُ‏ ‏الضَّلاَلَةُ‏ فَرِيقًا‏ ‏هَدَى‏ ‏وَفَرِيقًا‏ ‏حَقَّ‏ some He has guided and some are doomed astray

3 misguidedness, going astray

(27:81) وَمَا‏ ‏أَنْتَ‏ ‏بِهَادِي‏ ‏الْعُمْيِ‏ ‏عَنْ‏ ‏ضَلاَلَتِهِمْ‏ nor can you guide the blind from their misguidedness

4 error

(7:61) ‏يَاقَوْمِ‏ ‏لَيْسَ‏ ‏بِي‏ ‏ضَلاَلَةٌ my people, there is no error in me.

entries.label: ضَلَّ
entries.definitionHtml:
ضَلَّ ḍalla i I [v. intrans.]

1 to go astray, to lose the way

(53:2) مَا‏ ‏ضَلَّ‏ ‏صَاحِبُكُمْ‏ ‏وَمَا‏ ‏غَوَى‏ your fellow man has not strayed, nor has he erred

2 to err, to fail to find out

(20:52)‏عِلْمُهَا‏ ‏عِنْدَ‏ ‏رَبِّي‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏كِتَابٍ‏ ‏لاَ‏ ‏يَضِلُّ‏ ‏رَبِّي‏ ‏وَلاَ‏ ‏يَنْسَى‏ knowledge of them is with my Lord, all in a record; my Lord does not err or forget

3 [with prep. عَنْ] to deviate from, to stray from

(53:30) ‏إِنَّ‏ ‏رَبَّكَ‏ ‏هُوَ‏ ‏أَعْلَمُ‏ ‏بِمَنْ‏ ‏ضَلَّ‏ ‏عَنْ‏ ‏سَبِيلِهِ‏ your Lord knows best who strays from His path

4 to go missing, to depart

(11:21) ‏وَضَلَّ‏ ‏عَنْهُمْ‏ ‏مَا‏ ‏كَانُوا‏ ‏يَفْتَرُونَ‏ and what they fabricated will go missing from them [will not come to help them]

5 to desert, to fail

(17:67) وَإِذَا‏ ‏مَسَّكُمُ‏ الضُّرُّ‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏الْبَحْر ضَلَّ‏ ‏مَنْ‏ ‏تَدْعُونَ‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏ ‏إِيَّاهُ‏ when affliction befalls you at sea, those you call upon–save Him–desert you

6 to get lost, to be dissipated, to become absorbed *

(32:10) وَقَالُوا‏ ‏أَئِذَا‏ ‏ضَلَلْنَا‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏الأَرْضِ‏ ‏أَئِنَّا‏ ‏لَفِي‏ ‏خَلْقٍ‏ ‏جَدِيدٍ‏ they say, ‘What?!–When we have died [lit. become absorbed into the earth], will we really be created anew?!’

7 to forget

(2:282) أَنْ‏ ‏تَضِلَّ‏ ‏إِحْدَاهُمَا‏ ‏فَتُذَكِّرَ‏ ‏إِحْدَاهُمَا‏ ‏الأُخْرَى‏ so that if one of the two [women] should forget (or, make an error), the other can remind her II [v. trans.] to lose, to miss

(5:12) ‏فَمَنْ‏ ‏كَفَرَ‏ ‏بَعْدَ‏ ‏ذَلِكَ ‏مِنْكُمْ‏ ‏فَقَدْ‏ ‏ضَلَّ‏ ‏سَوَاءَ‏ ‏السَّبِيلِ‏ so whoever of you denies [the truth] after this, will have lost the right path.

entries.label: مُضِلٌّ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُضِلٌّ muḍill [act. part.; pl. مُضِلّون muḍillūn] one who misleads, causes to go astray

(39:37) وَمَنْ‏ ‏يَهْدِ‏ ‏اللَّهُ‏ ‏فَمَا‏ ‏لَهُ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏مُضِلٍّ‏ whosoever God guides, there is no one to mislead [him].
